reuse.why: Uses the shared link.assertBankAccountNotLinked and link.findOrCreateBank and generalises the Akahu download into a parameterised helper, but the account upsert, initial sync and sync-event part of linking is pasted rather than shared.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a ~70-line near-verbatim copy of linkAkahuAccount (upgrade-or-insert, payee creation, syncAccount, handleSyncResponse, sync-event), adding a sixth copy of the link flow.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts and types in types/models, matching the existing providers.

scope.why: Server-side as requested; renaming the Akahu download to a shared helper is a justified refactor that serves the change.

maintainability.why: The shared download helper is a good step, but the copied link flow means fixes to linking must be applied in six functions; the 'AkahuStyle' name ties a generic helper to one provider.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing link.ts guard and bank helpers; there is no shared link-flow abstraction in the tree to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts is an open copy of linkAkahuAccount; the download duplication was removed by parameterising it.
